# What should you charge for a YouTube sponsorship?

> Free YouTube sponsorship rate calculator. Enter your median views, niche and format to get a price range for an integration, dedicated video or mention, plus what to add for whitelisting and exclusivity. No sign-up, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
